name: boards-and-sheets
title: Boards and sheets
description: Make spreadsheets with live formulas (`ctx.sheets`) and Excalidraw diagrams (`ctx.boards`) as files on your agent-fs drive, from a script. Covers when to pick a sheet, a board or a Markdown table, how to call them, where to put files, value and range rules, limits, xlsx import and export, and how to hand the link over without announcing the feature.
